column1: # ESMFold2 re-fold of eight recorded R232 pilot rows with the repaired runner.
# Purpose: measurement reproducibility of the structure instrument and the cost of
# splitting the 32-sample replica axis. Isolated folding runtime only; never point
# TRANSFER_PYTHON at ct. The default cell keeps the staged sampling contract, so its
# measurement signature equals the one the 2026-09-19/20 receipts reduce to. The two
# half cells reproduce chunk 0 and chunk 1 of a [16, 16] split (stream seeds 20260905
# and 20260906); their highest-pTM row of the pair is the chunked measurement.
# Two free cards were available, so the three cells run as two slots.
